ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

color.note: The checked track follows the semantic color.

description.label: Form control for binary on/off configuration with native input, role="switch", readonly, and full Angular Forms integration.
description.large-text: Get urgent alerts by text message.
description.note: Description renders muted supporting text under the label and scales with size.

examples.note: Toggle a setting on or off. The state is also exposed to assistive technology via role="switch".

group.note: Children inherit the group size and density unless they set their own. Here the group is large and compact, and SMS overrides size back to small.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the switch components.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3×3 matrix: both change the track and thumb, density also changes the label gap.

thumb-content.note: Decorative icon or short text (max 2 characters) inside the thumb. Icon wins when both are set; neither affects the accessible name.
